<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment combining multiple constructs -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &internal;, and other entities inside namespace.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Root Base">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % paramDTD "<!ENTITY paramEnt 'Parameter Entity Text'>">
  %paramDTD;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY sample SYSTEM "sample.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?target-pi processing instruction data with ¶mEnt; reference?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/org/meta">
  <!-- Comment: Testing nested parameter entities and PIs -->
  <meta:details>
    <?meta-action type="validate"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw CDATA block with unparsed entity reference &sample;
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <item>¶mEnt;</item>
  <item>&combined;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Value 2">
  <!ENTITY % localParam "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*> <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  %localParam;
  <?custom-notation test?>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-rng"?>
<document xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/doc" xmlns:ns="http://schemas.example.com/ns">
  <!-- Complex comment block with DTD parameter entity side-effects -->
  <section ns:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      <sub xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/ns">Nested CDATA content &e2;</sub>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <sub ns:id="s2">&e2;</sub>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY g1 "Global Entity">
  <!ENTITY g2 "&g1; - Secondary">
  <!ENTITY % extMacro SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %extMacro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction data="value'with'quotes"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns/1.0" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive metadata comment -->
  <record xlink:type="locator" dc:identifier="rec-001">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with markup <record>&g2;</record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&g2;</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY delta 'γ Delta'>">
  %p1;
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY rawdata SYSTEM "data.bin" NDATA bin>
]>
<?perf-log active="yes" level="debug"?>
<system xmlns="http://system.org/schema" xmlns:cfg="http://system.org/schema/config">
  <!-- Deep entity chain test inside comment -->
  <cfg:node cfg:name="main">
    <![CDATA[
      <node>δ</node> inside CDATA section.
    ]]>
  </cfg:node>
  <node>δ</node>
</system>
